title: Adults who gave regular care to a family member or friend (BRFSS 2025)
summary: In the 27 areas that asked the caregiver module, 23.4% of adults (weighted) said that in the past 30 days they provided regular care or assistance to a friend or family member with a health problem or disability: 37,131 of 154,632 answers (24.0% unweighted).

title: Caregivers whose care recipient also has Alzheimer’s, dementia or another cognitive impairment (BRFSS 2025)
summary: Among caregivers who answered the follow-up question in the 27 areas that asked, 14.5% (weighted) said the person they care for also has Alzheimer’s disease, dementia or another cognitive impairment disorder: 4,630 of 32,510 answers (14.2% unweighted).

title: Adults 45 and over reporting memory or thinking difficulties that are happening more often or getting worse (BRFSS 2025)
summary: In the 16 areas that asked the cognitive decline module, 19.2% of adults 45 and over (weighted) said that in the past 12 months they had difficulties with thinking or memory that were happening more often or getting worse: 15,184 of 74,780 answers (20.3% unweighted).

title: Deaths with Alzheimer’s disease or dementia as the underlying cause, United States, 2022 to 2024 (CDC NCHS)
summary: Death records with an underlying cause of Alzheimer’s disease (G30), vascular dementia (F01) or unspecified dementia (F03): 234,649 in 2022, 223,553 in 2023 and 224,680 in 2024.
